validation.3070_scope: No changed 3070 code, data, profile, runtime or new scientific execution; no new 3070 check claimed

preserved: API, Slack socket, dispatch, Quant Feed, accounts and other workers
frozen research and qlab config mounts
role settings, model route, official account selection
preflight: Acquire deployment/backup lock; reread latest worker, application image and compose labels
Record all container IDs and active requests/jobs and compare immutable input/packet identities
Create consistent DB/config/research/qlab backup with existing state_backup tool
Use actual active compose files with worker-only image and COMPANY_CODE_COMMIT overlay
If code/config pins changed concurrently, stop and integrate before activation
postcheck: Inspect installed source SHA and code/qdata pins
Verify prior stage attempt receipts remain and same-attempt correction preserves file_progress
Verify rejected say causes no Slack write and one corrected response uses empty say
Verify other container IDs/configs unchanged and no mission/job invented

rollback.method: Restore saved worker-only image/env/compose overlay; retain all DB/read/model receipts. Do not reset stable request IDs or replay uncertain effects.
